{{Quote|You&mdash;go to the isolation chambers in the pits beneath the temples. If my plan fails, you will be a last surprise for them!|Exar Kun to Kalgrath|<ref name="TSW6">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War 6|''Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War'' 6]]</ref>}}
The '''isolation chambers''' were hidden rooms housed in the subterranean galleries beneath the temples on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]<ref name="TSW6" /> built by [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]].<ref name="DSS">''[[The Dark Side Sourcebook]]''</ref> Their purpose was to host the [[Massassi/Legends|Massassi]] warrior [[Kalgrath]], who was put in hibernation in [[3996 BBY]].<ref name="TSW6" /> The chambers contained a suspended animation capsule and a primitive [[Computer/Legends|computer]] in which part of the history of the Massassi was preserved. A secret underground corridor to the rooms was located behind a blank wall in the [[Great Temple/Legends|Great Temple]] main hall, which had become the Massassi Station's hangar by the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="TNB" />

Shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], a [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bomber]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] crashed in the Massassi ruins, which caused damage in the isolation rooms and woke up Kalgrath. The hero of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to open the blank wall and discovered the isolation rooms, where he learned about the ancient Massassi and their last guardian.<ref name="TNB" />

==Behind the scenes==
While the [[2001]] [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] sourcebook ''[[The Dark Side Sourcebook]]'' established that the isolation chambers are located beneath the [[Temple of Fire]],<ref name="DSS" /> the [[2008]] reference book ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' implies it is located in the [[Great Temple/Legends|Great Temple's]] lower levels.<ref name="CSWE Night beast">{{CSWECite|II|379|night beast}}</ref>
